brief: @buildthis.bisks.net drone synth, patches saved in pds, built in looping and fx (reverb, delay, fuzz, others), measured in seconds rather than measures (think a stopwatch with a lap button)
note: droneloop: 4-voice drone synth with reverb/delay/fuzz/chorus and a stopwatch looper — START, LAP sets the loop length, more laps overdub layers. Patches save to your PDS.
